title: Magento API: shop products, prices, stock & reviews · API.SH
snippet:
The API.SH Magento API reads the public catalog of any Magento 2 or Adobe Commerce shop and returns structured JSON. Search a shop's products with words, category, price range, SKU and its own filterable attributes, then read one product with prices, tier prices, stock, gallery, configurable variants, bundle items and native reviews. You can also get the shop's category tree.
- **4** endpoints
- from **$1** / 1,000 calls
- **1,000** free credits / month
- failed calls **free**

Every Magento endpoint costs 1 credit per call: credits are $1 per 1,000 on a monthly plan, $2 pay-as-you-go. [Pricing](/pricing)
## Call the Magento API
Magento shop product search: GET https://api.api.sh/magento/v1/products
```
curl "https://api.api.sh/magento/v1/products?store=www.coxandcox.co.uk" \
-H "x-api-key: $APISH_KEY"
```
1. **Create a free account**Confirm your email and get 1,000 free credits every month. No card needed.
2. **Create an API key**One key works for all 484 platforms.
3. **Send the request**JSON back in one call. Add `output=csv` or `output=ndjson` for files.
## Why API.SH for Magento data
- Public data only: no Magento login, cookies or account needed
- One key and one response shape for Magento and 483 other platforms
- Built and maintained by API.SH, not third-party publishers
- Pay per call; errors on our side cost nothing
- Live [status](https://status.api.sh) for every endpoint
## API.SH vs the official Magento API
Magento and Adobe Commerce have official REST and GraphQL APIs, documented by Adobe, which are meant for the store's own team and integrations and need credentials. API.SH reads the public storefront of any Magento 2 shop, so you need no token or access to the shop, and it returns the same JSON shape on every shop.

How much does the Magento API cost?+
Every Magento endpoint costs 1 credit per call. On a monthly plan 1,000 credits cost $1 (Starter is $50/month for 50,000 credits). Pay-as-you-go is $2 per 1,000 credits, with top-ups from $15 that never expire.
Is there a free trial?+
Yes. Every account gets 1,000 free credits every month. That is 1,000 calls to /magento/v1/categories at 1 credit each.

title: anchorterminal.com/tools/adobe-commerce
snippet:
> Commerce platform from Adobe, built on the open-source Magento core. It runs as Adobe Commerce as a Cloud Service, on Adobe's cloud infrastructure or on the merchant's own servers, and agents reach a store through its REST and GraphQL APIs.

Public Swagger files cover 510 REST operations for the cloud service, the GraphQL schema carries cart, checkout and order mutations, and the cloud service authenticates by OAuth 2 through Adobe IMS. No request rate limit or idempotency key was found in the API documentation, Adobe publishes no MCP server for Commerce, and a licence starts with a sales order.
## Facts
| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Vendor | Adobe Inc. (https://business.adobe.com/products/commerce.html) |
| Kind | HTTP API |
| Category | Commerce & checkout (https://www.anchorterminal.com/categories/commerce) |
| Transport | HTTP |
| Auth | OAuth or key · Access comes from the merchant, with no Adobe review of the caller. On Adobe Commerce as a Cloud Service an organisation admin creates an OAuth credential in Adobe Developer Console, and calls carry an Adobe IMS bearer token, from client credentials with the `commerce.accs` scope or from a user flow tied to an Admin role.

| Pricing | Freemium (Freemium) · No price was read. business.adobe.com timed out on every request on 8 October 2026, and the cloud service licensing terms define an account as one opened under a sales order. No sandbox or trial open without a contract was found in the pages we could read. Magento Open Source, the core with the same REST and GraphQL framework, is free under OSL 3.0, so an owner can start on a self-hosted store with no contract. Its Composer install needs keys from a Commerce Marketplace account.
